definitions.explanation: A copy of a key made to open the same lock.

examples.japanese: {合鍵|あいかぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To have a duplicate key made.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合鍵|あいかぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}してある→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: I've given my mother a spare key to my apartment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}って→付き合う：02291_tsukiau⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧たったとき、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合鍵|あいかぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When we'd been dating a year, she gave me a key to her apartment for the first time.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合鍵|あいかぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to have a key copied
- {合鍵|あいかぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to give someone a spare key

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Giving a partner the {合鍵|あいかぎ} to one's apartment is a familiar marker of a serious relationship in Japanese dramas and songs. In rental apartments, copying a key may need the landlord's permission.

WRITING:
- Also written {合|あ}い{鍵|かぎ}.
